summary: Iter 247 — Full backend+frontend E2E validation of Katrina Chat-to-CRUD, Four-Eyes, contextual cancel, and live-linkage. All 5 backend pytest tests PASS and all 4 frontend E2E flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Purchase draft cards render the full contextual action set (approve, reject, transfer, add-VAT-15%, add-supplier) — buttons rely on backend-provided endpoints (good, no hardcoded URLs).
Live linkage (finance:updated + runtime:changed) works well: badge count updated in real time (15→16→15) without page reload while drawer was open.
The 'اعتمادات كاترينا' intent correctly triggers runtime.pending_approvals tool and returns a rich Markdown table + ApprovalCards (not a generic LLM answer).
seed_data_creation: Test purchases created during runs (auto-cancelled by cancel-flow test). Additional pending drafts left in DB (expected, requires Four-Eyes approval to clear).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://erp-compliance-check.preview.emergentagent.com. Chat responses wrapped {success, data}; assistant response text lives at data.response (not data.reply). Tool results at data.tool_results[].tool. Purchase intent field is 'question' when it invokes a tool; 'action' when it creates a draft with executed.status=pending_approval. FAB testid: unified-assistant-fab; input: assistant-input; send: assistant-send-btn; approval cards match [data-testid^='assistant-card-ApprovalCard'].
verified_flows: POST /api/assistant/chat present-tense purchase → executed.status=pending_approval, no NameError
POST /api/assistant/chat past-tense purchase → also pending_approval (not parts search)
POST /api/assistant/chat 'اعتمادات كاترينا' → tool runtime.pending_approvals invoked, rich table returned
Contextual cancel in same session → 'تم إلغاء المسودة المعلقة', no journal_id prompt
Four-Eyes: مدير self-approve → 403 four_eyes_violation; احمد1 approve → 200
Frontend /financial-control loads with all 4 tabs + katrina badge
Bot ApprovalCard renders with contextual actions (اعتماد/رفض/تحويل بنكي/إضافة ضريبة 15%/إضافة المورد)
Live linkage: badge auto-updated 15→16 after purchase, 16→15 after cancel — no manual reload
